thread:
Anna (Product): quick idea — propose a new 'elastic commit' SKU that has a smaller base commit + pooled surge credits. targets mid-market & scale-ups. thoughts?

Mike (Finance): curious on the math. what's smaller? 25% of current starter commit?

Anna (Product): thinking 30% floor, with a monthly pooled surge bucket equal to 0.5x the commit. customers can hit burst up to commit*2 before we throttle.

Jess (Sales): this would help a few pilots. can we add a hard cap option for enterprise deals? some customers will want a true ceiling.

Sanjay (Eng): implementation concerns: pooled surge means we need cross-customer accounting + new telemetry. doable but nontrivial. will add ~2 sprints of infra work.

Lina (Legal): we need to be explicit in contract language about how surge consumption is metered and when we convert to overage rates. send a draft clause.

Anna (Product): draft clause take: `If monthly usage > commit + surge_bucket then overage billed at 1.25x on tokens above threshold.` open to other multipliers.

Mike (Finance): 1.25x seems low for unbounded overage. finance prefers stepped pricing: 1.5x up to 1.5x commit, 2.0x beyond. reduces abuse.

Jess (Sales): stepped pricing ok but adds complexity for quoting. can we expose a simple single-line estimate in the quote UI and keep the stepped logic in the contract?

Ruth (Product Ops): Launch criteria suggestion: 3 pilot customers signed, infra telemetry for burst per-customer + cluster, billing simulation verified for 2 months, legal clause approved.

Sanjay (Eng): to add: API change for contract flags + billing tag on requests; backend needs a global surge allocator that respects region affinity. rough infra tasks:
```
- usage-metering service update
- surge allocator (per-month window)
- per-customer billing tags
- dashboard + alerts
```

Anna (Product): timeline ask: target beta in 6 weeks. is that realistic?

Sanjay (Eng): 6 weeks tight. if we scope MVP to single-region + conservative allocator (first-come-first-serve) — maybe. full cross-region fairness is longer.

Mike (Finance): also need a way to reconcile credits monthly. ops can't do manual adjustments at scale. please include automatic reconciliation and export for finance.

Lina (Legal): also note: for regulatory customers, surge buckets must be opt-in; otherwise they default to fixed-commit only. add that to launch docs.

Jess (Sales): FYI: two pilots asked for a 90-day trial on surge credits — prefer to auto-convert to paid after trial. is that supported?

Anna (Product): okay action items: @Sanjay scope MVP (single-region, simple allocator) + time estimate; @Mike propose stepped multipliers; @Lina produce contract language options (single-tier vs stepped); @Ruth build launch checklist including pilot gating. I'll consolidate and move to roadmap board. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Recorded action items: [Sanjay] scope MVP; [Mike] propose multipliers; [Lina] contract draft; [Ruth] launch checklist. Deadline: next-week sync.

Jess (Sales): thanks — I'll loop Sales ENG on quoting UX once we have the multiplier math.

Mike (Finance): one more ask — floor revenue guarantee: suggest minimum 3-month commit for elastic SKU to reduce churn risk.

Anna (Product): noted, add minimum term to checklist.

Sanjay (Eng): will post a tech-debt estimate in #eng-platform tomorrow.

Ruth (Product Ops): adding pilot success metrics: 1) <5% latency regressions under burst, 2) accurate billing within 0.5% vs simulation, 3) no customer-impacting quotas exceeded.

Anna (Product): perfect. we'll review at next roadmap deep-dive.
